objective: Exploratory visual comparison of specified glyph forms across real manuscripts; no phonetic, linguistic or author attribution.

sources.coordinate_frame: Actual decoded delivered JPEG, not conflicting IIIF info dimensions

families: loop with descending or trailing stroke
selection: Principal assistant manually selects legible glyph ROIs within declared source regions, seeking candidate component resemblances. Exploratory purposive sampling, not random/exhaustive or an unbiased similarity estimate. Glyph boxes and context frozen before reader judgements.
roles: second Voynich candidate of the proposed same visual family, not human-validated gold
image_policy: Retain native RGB ROI and context; common display height, aspect ratio preserved, nearest-neighbor scaling; no rotation, mirror, cleanup, dewarping or inpainting.

review.reason: Handwriting and colour can reveal origins; principal assistant selected the examples; AI reviews not human palaeographic validation
review.forbidden_inference: No assigning letter values, sounds, language, meaning or common author from resemblance.

outputs: lossless source tiles and glyph/context ROIs
frozen randomized presentation mapping and sheets
two independently produced AI review records
statistical_scope: No p-values, no accuracy against expert gold, no claim of a related alphabet from selected examples.
Fontana_reading_control: Verify original and1910 transcription provenance; no glyph-to-Latin mapping asserted without a checked alignment. This visual pilot is distinct from a held-out decipherment trial.
